title: FileResponse accepts inverted single-byte Range like bytes=5-4
author: nikolauspschuetz
body_preview: ### Bug  `FileResponse._parse_range_header` rejects a Range only when `start > end`, but `bytes=5-4` parses to the empty half-open range `(5, 5)` and slips past that guard. title: Token expiry check uses strict less-than (<) creating 1-second stale-token window
author: StimeGuan
body_preview: ## Bug Description  In `knox/auth.py` at lines 107 and 113, expired token pruning uses strict less-than (`expiry < timezone.now()`) instead of `expiry <= timezone.now()`.
